name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Exactly two of these are true: Ames goes with Bungalow; Dunn goes with Bungalow; Library goes with Noah.
Either Nash goes with Jonah or Noah goes with Frost.
Library, Studio, and Workshop go with Dunn, Nash, and Iris, in some order.
Either Iris goes with Ames or Nash goes with Studio.

hints.text: Suppose Library didn't go with Noah — that hits a contradiction, so it does.
chain: Start by assuming Library does not go with Noah.
From the clue “Exactly two of these are true: Ames goes with Bungalow; Dunn goes with Bungalow; Library goes with Noah” — Ames must go with Bungalow.
From the clue “Exactly two of these are true: Ames goes with Bungalow; Dunn goes with Bungalow; Library goes with Noah” — Dunn must go with Bungalow.
Bungalow goes with Ames, so Dunn can't go with Bungalow. But Dunn was already shown to go with Bungalow — a contradiction.
So Library goes with Noah.
